headline: Diamond Power Infrastructure posts Q2 net profit of Rs 107.88 crore
hook: Strong quarter on record revenue for Diamond Power
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure reported a 349 percent year-on-year surge in net profit to Rs 107.88 crore for the second quarter. The company posted record revenue of Rs 1,031.90 crore during the period. The strong financial performance reflects significant top-line growth and improved profitability. Retail investors holding the stock can assess the operational scaling reflected in these numbers.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings boost near-term sentiment for Diamond Power shareholders.

headline: Prataap Snacks appoints Jitendra Nayyar as Non-Executive Independent Director
summary: Prataap Snacks Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Jitendra Nayyar as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective October 30, 2026. This corporate governance update reflects ongoing board restructuring at the listed snack maker. Indian retail investors tracking management changes in mid-cap consumer companies should note this leadership addition. whats_next: October 30, 2026 effective date for the appointment

headline: Prataap Snacks receives stock exchange approval to reclassify promoters
hook: Promoter status change cleared for Prataap Snacks
summary: Prataap Snacks has received formal approval from the stock exchanges to reclassify its promoters. This administrative corporate action alters the promoter group shareholding structure.
